items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Then I had another little -- fine little bass player, George Mason, one of the Mason brothers.

ctx.x: Something would happen, a guy would get sick or something, because I think Herschel Coleman passed while he was on that job. Then Norman Bowden. Then I had another little -- fine little bass player, George Mason, one of the Mason brothers. There are three brothers here, Mason Brothers, and they're all marvelous, excellent bass players, and this guy was the youngest of the brothers. Never studied music, you know.
But he is so talented. He can just hear something and just fall right in, just a natural. He's just a natural.
